answer: Beat sybils with a per-identity VDF: each epoch, every identity must finish a sequential-squaring proof tuned to one full tide of compute time, verifiable in milliseconds and bound to a public beacon. A farm cloning N identities cannot parallelize one machine: each proof burns its own tide of sequential time, like water through one narrow karst conduit. Clones queue on the same ledge, so the Nth clone finishes N tides late and misses the cutoff. Attackers pay N x T seconds while honest agents pay one tide; buying more GPUs buys no speed, since squaring chains cannot fork across cores.
